name: gitauto-cmd
description: Token-cheap Git delivery commands on haiku, backed by bundled scripts. `/gitauto-cmd:branch-out` leaves main; `/gitauto-cmd:open-pr` opens a PR and waits for green CI; `/gitauto-cmd:ship` runs the full flow through merge, sync, cleanup, and an opt-in tag prompt. An Opus PR writer is used only for complex changes.
